tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod yul gyi dpe tho bzhugs so/ /

thog mar gsol 'debs/ (ka dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed/ (kha ngo sprod nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ (ga sgrub thabs byin rlabs sgo 'byed/ (nga sgrub thabs dngos grub sgo 'byed kyi shog dril/ (ca rmi lam nyi zla sgo 'byed/ (cha 'pho ba thar pa'i sgo 'byed/ (ja bar do 'od gsal sgo 'byed/ (nya gegs sel rten 'brel sgo 'byed/ (ta bogs 'don yon tan sgo 'byed/ (ta gzhan don phrin las sgo 'byed/ (tha grub mtha' khyad 'phags sgo 'byed/ (da nyams khrid zhag bdun ma/ (na gdams pa thugs kyi snying po/ (pa zab don gyi gzhung*/ (pha spyi khrid chen mo/ (ba gsal ba'i me long*/ (ma nyams len 'dus pa/ (tsa sde brgyad 'bum bskul/ (tsha drag las/ (dza nag sbyor/ (wa bka' tshoms/ dge'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ - PAGE 1 -
